title: Split Array with Equal Sum
goal: Solve Split Array with Equal Sum: Given an integer array nums, determine whether there exist indices i < j < k that split the array into four non-empty parts (excluding nums[i], nums[j], nums[k]) with equal sums.
strategy: Given an integer array nums, determine whether there exist indices i < j < k that split the array into four non-empty parts (excluding nums[i], nums[j], nums[k]) with equal sums.
inputRules: Enter a comma-separated list of integers
Keep the array to 24 numbers or fewer
